summary: Madison County, MT cupola cabin dated to 1921 and abandoned around 1930; listed as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Gone; Rex's Fire Lookout Page marks it Removed with no date

events.note: Emergency telephone line under construction to the peak and planned use as a fire lookout station, per a July 1915 Spokesman-Review item quoted on Rex's page
D-6 cupola cabin, per the firelookout.com listing
Listing says the cabin was abandoned around 1930

evidence.supports: July 1915 item: forest supervisor overseeing construction of an emergency telephone line to Lone Mountain
evidence.quote: supervise the construction of the emergency telephone line to Lone mountain

evidence.supports: 1915 item: peak to be used as a fire lookout station for the Madison and Gallatin national forests
evidence.quote: This peak will be used as a fire lookout station for the Madison and Gallatin national forests

evidence.supports: D-6 cupola cabin built in 1921 and abandoned around 1930
evidence.quote: This D-6 cupola cabin, built in 1921, was abandoned around 1930.

evidence.supports: listing names the Beaverhead/Gallatin National Forests
Rex's page names the Beaverhead National Forest
Rex's page marks the site Removed
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists type Ground and status Gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Rex's page gives one forest for the site, the Beaverhead National Forest; the firelookout.com listing names the Beaverhead/Gallatin National Forests, and the 1915 item quoted on Rex's page names the Madison and Gallatin national forests. The facts record keeps the Beaverhead National Forest; the Gallatin appears in the listing and the 1915 item.

notes_for_editor: Brief record (Ground, Gone) matches the FFLA index. The 1921 build and around-1930 abandonment rest on one listing. The 1915 item describes a planned telephone line and lookout station, not a built cabin, so it is logged as other. Two searches found no staffing or fire history and no description of the site now. No source states access, so the access key is omitted.
